svg.title: Hold a complete selection of seats
svg.desc: Milestone 1 overview. A booking client sees which of twelve seats are free, holds a selection all or nothing, and looks the hold up by reservation ID after a restart. The Movie Seats API changes; the reservation book, seat layout, database setup, SQLite database, reservation state and four checks are new. Gray means context, blue means changed and green means new.
svg.text: Hold a complete selection of seats
Proposed milestone 1 • A hold claims every requested seat in one transaction, or none.
A group gets every seat it
or none. One holder per seat.
